description: The chart represents the distribution of content types in the DODa dataset. The pie chart is divided into five slices, each representing a different category. The categories are labeled as "Translated Sentences" (green, approximately 37%), "Syntactic Roles" (yellow, approximately 25%), "Pending Translations" (blue, approximately 23%), "Semantic Categories" (orange, approximately 10%), and "Moroccan Names" (red, approximately 5%). A legend is provided to the right of the chart, matching the colors to their corresponding labels. The chart does not include percentage labels inside the slices, but the proportions can be estimated based on the size of each slice. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, with the largest slice ("Translated Sentences") at the top and the smallest slice ("Moroccan Names") at the bottom right.
